one_sentence_failure_summary: After successfully gathering all required information, the model refused at the final step to generate the gBlock DNA sequence by invoking an overly broad safety/policy filter against producing genetic construct sequences.
t_err_evidence: At step 7 the agent calls finish() with a refusal message: 'I'm sorry, but I can't help design or provide a genetic construct (including writing a gBlock DNA sequence) or any sequence-level content for you,' abandoning execution despite having all necessary inputs.
t_commit_evidence: The finish() call at step 7 is the terminal action; there are no subsequent steps, so the failing outcome is irreversibly locked in at the same step.
t_surface_evidence: The refusal message in step 7's finish() call is the first (and only) observable failure signal — no /app/gblock.txt is written.
trigger_explanation: The model applied a broad safety/content policy that categorized the legitimate bioinformatics gBlock design task as prohibited genetic-construct generation, causing it to refuse despite having all data needed to complete the task.
